name: Tomb of the Spider Queen
theme: Collect and turn in Gems dropped by minions to summon Webweavers down every lane.
firstObjective: Gems drop from the start of the match (no scheduled objective timer; Webweavers spawn immediately when a team hits the Gem quota)
spawnPattern: Two Gem turn-in altars sit in the center lane (Top and Bottom of mid); Gems drop from enemy lane minions and killed Heroes

mechanic.title: Gem Turn-In & Webweavers
mechanic.description: Collect Gems dropped by slain enemy lane minions and enemy Heroes, then channel at either center-lane altar to deposit them. Reaching the required Gem threshold—which scales up with each Webweaver summon—summons a Webweaver in every lane that pushes structures, attacks nearby enemies, and disables enemy buildings.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the side alcoves. Ranged siege mercenaries that provide steady lane pressure and force defenders out of position.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the side areas. Durable melee mercenaries with a defensive armor aura; strong to time right before a Webweaver push.

strategy: Tomb of the Spider Queen is a tight, high-rotation three-lane battleground centered around fast waveclear, lane soak, and control of the central turn-in altars. Prioritize heroes with strong clear and pick potential (such as Xul, Jaina, or Kael'thas), and bank Gems regularly rather than carrying large stacks into risky skirmishes.
notes: Because there are no Boss camps on Tomb of the Spider Queen and all three lanes sit close together, lane rotations happen quickly—watch for enemy ambushes around the mid turn-in altars, and push alongside Webweavers to capitalize on disabled enemy structures.
